dataset: MNIST test set (yann.lecun.com/exdb/mnist; files from storage.googleapis.com/cvdf-datasets/mnist, MD5 9fb629c4… images, ec29112d… labels)
method: 30 printed InkTally sheets × 8 numeric answers; numbers 1–999 written with MNIST test digits (each digit image used once); about 40% written wrong on purpose; seeded photo distortions; InkTally scanner + one cloud read per sheet + code marking.
